caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with a rich brown color and a classic design, featuring two vertical columns on either side of the front panel. The upper section of the clock face shows Roman numerals arranged in a circular pattern, with ornate floral decorations around the numerals and a pair of clock hands in the center. The surface of the clock face appears weathered and slightly faded. Below the clock face, there is a glass panel revealing a curled, light brown and orange tabby cat resting inside the lower compartment of the clock case, lying on what looks like a light green fabric or cushion. The background of the image is an off-white, plain surface with no additional objects or decorations, and the artist's name, "RAYMOND REINMAN," is printed in small text at the bottom right.
title: Shelf Clock
